# Retirement Decumulation Skill for Muse

Turn a retirement portfolio into sustainable lifetime income, with real math instead of slogans: sequence-of-returns risk (with a worked example showing how an early crash changes everything), the 4% rule and its assumptions (Bengen/Trinity backtests, and why 3–3.5% may fit longer retirements), Guyton-Klinger-style guardrails with concrete cut/raise rules, RMD calculation from the IRS Uniform Lifetime Table, Social Security claiming math (early reduction, delayed credits, breakeven ages, survivor benefits), gap-year bracket-filling with Roth conversions, bucket strategies versus total-return, and SPIA annuitization as longevity insurance — with worked examples, key formulas, a companion Python script, and a blunt common-pitfalls list. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: the content is US-flavored — Social Security, RMDs, IRAs, SECURE 2.0 — so the math is universal but the rules need adapting to your country's retirement and tax system; and it educates, it does not give personalized financial advice. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
